Owen keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. The balcony looked quieter than usual that evening. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. What's more, he cleaned the window with an old rag.

People around Owen often share different ideas about the balcony. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, he drinks tea without sugar.

The old photo album has become an important part of daily life. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The channel airs the same infomercial at three every morning.

Little by little, things began to change. At first, Owen found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, the veteran pol knew how to win over skeptical voters.
On Wednesday evenings, Owen reviews the notes from class. Owen has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. Owen is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu.
